title: BloodPressureSeries
description: A patient record with a single coded injury diagnosis and a repeatable blood pressure measurement subtree. Use this fixture to exercise iteration over repeated source nodes (for_each_source / array paths) while mapping a non-repeated coded element at the root.

diagnosis.description: Encounter diagnosis as a WHO ICD-10 coded injury (Chapter XIX, S00–T98). One diagnosis per record; not repeated on each measurement.

code.description: WHO ICD-10 four-character category from a small simulated injury subset.

codeSystem.description: WHO International Statistical Classification of Diseases and Related Health Problems, 10th Revision.

display.description: ICD-10 category title matching the selected code.

display.const: Fracture of lower end of radius

measurements.description: Repeated blood pressure readings. Each item is a complete measurement with its own timestamp.

timestamp.description: The date and time when this measurement was taken.

systolic.description: Systolic blood pressure in mmHg (the top number).

diastolic.description: Diastolic blood pressure in mmHg (the bottom number).

pulse.description: Heart rate in beats per minute (optional).

bodyPosition.description: The position of the patient during this measurement (optional).
